text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a Trainer from Tracen Academy! 
Welcome to our club. Come, let me show you 
around the facilities.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I'll go check on the juniors, then. 
I'll report their clocked times to you 
later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I was given a tour of the club's 
facilities. 
After walking around for a bit, we arrived 
at the wide track...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us begin. 
Show me the fruits of your training.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Good, the final stretch is almost here. 
Release the stamina you've saved up till 
now... and close the distance all at once!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, ma'am! Taaahhh~~~!
choice_data_list:
(So that's how Phalaeno runs her 
practice!)

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
Things are going smoothly today, too. 
She's deeply adored by her juniors. 
Those girls always look forward to 
training with her.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Splendid. Your pacing has improved 
remarkably since last time. 
Keep this up, and your deceleration in the 
final stretch should lessen.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Thank you so much, !

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Phalaeno-san, could you run tandem with me 
one more time? 
I feel like I'm just about to get the hang 
of it—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—My apologies, but that will be all for 
tandem running today. 
Would you mind if we went over your form 
instead?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm so sorry! 
It is still morning, after all... In that 
case, I'll go run! Please watch me!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we shall begin our martial arts 
practice. 
A sharp focus carries over into one's 
stride. —First, with kirikaeshi.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I was being shown around the indoor 
facility, I came across the practice 
grounds once more. 
It seems she looks after them in many 
ways, not just when it comes to running.
choice_data_list:
She really cares about her juniors, 
doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even now, after enrolling in the 
academy, she frequently visits like this. 
She truly is as dependable as they come.

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
We only hope for her success in the 
Twinkle Series. 
She is... the flower of our club, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the afternoon, after the facility tour 
was over, I gazed out at the scenery by 
myself. 
Beside the track, beautifully manicured 
flowers swayed gently in the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Ghh......! Just 200 more... No, 300!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was lapping the perimeter of the dojo 
walls at a ferocious speed. 
She must have been at it for a while—her 
face was twisted in anguish...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This morning, she had called off running 
tandem with her junior. 
If she was going to run this hard, she 
could have done so outdoors, but...?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Ah... Trainer, is that you? 
Forgive me, I didn't notice... Gh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wondering if she was hurt, I rushed over 
to her... She was burning up. 
Her fever was so intense I could feel the 
heat radiating off her just by getting 
close!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Think nothing of it. 
This much is... a regular occurrence.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...My temperature has merely spiked. 
...I must prepare an ice pack.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could recover from my shock, she 
had returned to her room. 
...What was this nagging sense of 
dissonance? Up until now, she had seemed 
somehow—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize for alarming you earlier. 
My fever has already subsided. That is 
simply how I train on a daily basis.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Refraining from tandem runs in the 
morning. Training indoors away from 
sunlight. 
And the fluctuating temperature... The 
pieces of the puzzle clicked together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Normally, an umamusume's body temperature 
is low in the morning and rises in the 
afternoon. 
The reverse—a condition where body 
temperature spikes in the morning—is known 
as 'inverted body temperature.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to this condition, an umamusume with 
inverted body temperature suffers from 
unstable thermoregulation. 
At times, they are gripped by intense 
fevers, struggling to perform anywhere 
near their true ability.
choice_data_list:
With a condition like that, you still 
chose the path of racing...?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I have learned how to manage it. 
However... I still cannot overextend 
myself. 
Furthermore, my muscles tend to stiffen 
easily.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...When I was young, I felt nothing but 
resentment toward myself. 
I could not forgive my own frailty, 
collapsing so easily. —And yet.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: It was this training club that changed me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indoor training methods that minimize the 
impact on my body temperature. 
Thorough cooldown routines, and proper 
measures when fevers strike.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
This club confronted my condition with 
utmost sincerity. 
It is solely because of them that I was 
able to hone my running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had overcome a constitution unsuited 
for racing 
together with the club. All to run, all to 
move forward—
choice_data_list:
Even so, doing that kind of training with 
inverted body temperature...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—I understand your concern, and yet. 
I, and this club... have an aspiration to 
fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Past Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: “A G1 victory... you say?”

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
“I've been talking with the other staff. 
We hope that someday, a renowned horsegirl 
will blossom from this club.”

text_block_list.name: Past Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: “Someday... No—”

text_block_list.name: Past Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
“Then... I, Phalaenopsis, shall blossom 
into that flower.”

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—The club has bestowed so much kindness 
upon me for so long. 
How could I ever leave such a debt of 
gratitude unpaid?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
An inverted body temperature is a trifling 
matter! 
Something like that could never halt my 
stride.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
With my own hands, I shall gift this club 
a G1 victory. 
I will charge through the battlefield of 
racing and bloom in all my glory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wished to repay the club that raised 
her with victory. 
—In her dignified eyes burned a fierce 
resolve, akin to that of a dauntless 
warrior.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it is for a G1 victory... a racing 
career burdened by such physical 
afflictions 
is a long and grueling battle. What's 
more, she subjects herself to such harsh 
training...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry. 
I know how to manage my condition all too 
well. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: This path does not end with a single G1.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Just one... a victory for me alone is far 
from enough. 
My sights are set further beyond—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To make this club... into the “most 
beautiful garden.”
